english.title: Act as radiotelephony operator / flight engineer / navigator of EASA aircraft registered in the UK when unlicenced
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) acted as a flight

(A)_[radiotelephony operator]_
(B)_[engineer]_
(C)_[navigator]_of an EASA aircraft that was registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), without holding an appropriate licence granted or rendered valid under the Air Navigation Order 2009
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 50(3) and 241(7) of, and Part C of Schedule 13 to, the Air Navigation Order 2009.
